correctness.rationale: The object is the unordered collision-free topological configuration space, not a finite vertex configuration complex. The orientation-preserving signed coordinate permutations act faithfully on four body-diagonal lines and give S_4; central inversion splits off C_2. The natural comparison theorem for the Świątkowski complex and the equivariant reduced inclusion justify computing the action on reduced weight-three chains. An independent reconstruction (independent_check.py; ranks.out and characters.out) checked the chain dimensions (364,1404,1620,540), square-zero differentials and mod-32003 ranks (363,1033,540). Over Q the first and last ranks have upper bounds 363 and 540 by augmentation and domain dimension; Ko–Park gives b_1=7+1=8 for this planar 3-connected graph, forcing the middle rational rank 1033. The rational Betti vector is (1,8,47,0). Equal rational and mod-p homology dimensions in all degrees exclude p-torsion by universal coefficients, so the rational trace reduces to the calculated quotient trace; an integral finite-order trace of magnitude <=8 is uniquely determined by that residue for H_1. The independent signed chain supertraces, with no H_3 and trivial H_0, give all H_2 traces by Euler–Poincaré. Exact character inner products agree with the displayed multiplicities. The central trace -1 gives eigenspace dimensions 23 and 24. For the orbit statement, triangulate the finite ordered product equivariantly with the collision diagonals a subcomplex; after subdivision their complement retracts equivariantly onto a simplicial model, by renormalizing barycentric coordinates off the diagonal subcomplex. After subdividing to eliminate inversions, quotient homology over Q is computed by coinvariants for the finite action, equivalently invariants by averaging. This applies to the unordered configuration space and then its W-quotient, proving rational acyclicity without a freeness assumption on W. The frozen scripts were not executed and integral torsion is outside scope.

originality.rationale: The distinct November 8 catalogue record 4a7f5ab15bea gives the same three-particle space and ten-row full rational character for the same graph group, and states stronger integral homology. Its representative permutations give precisely the frozen signed-cycle classes with the same traces. The choice of wreath-product bipartitions versus S_4 x C_2 Specht labels is just a change of character basis. Both the eigenspace dimensions and absence of fixed vectors are stated there, and quotient rational acyclicity follows from finite-group rational coinvariants. This establishes equivalent mathematical coverage, not historical precedence or dependence from the November 1 and 8 path dates.
